brainstorm.description: Phase 1 (Standard): Interactive requirement scoping on top-tier reasoning at low token cost ($0.10/M input, $0.50/M output). Thinking: medium.

brainstorm-deep.description: Phase 1 (Complex Architecture): Deep-tier reasoning for microservice boundaries and microfrontend state federation ($0.66/M input, $0.022/M cache read). Thinking: high.

specification.description: Phase 2: OpenAPI contract definitions, state management, and acceptance criteria ($0.10/M input). Thinking: high.

plan.description: Phase 3 (Standard): Fast micro-task step planning ($0.15/M input, $0.003/M cache read). Thinking: provider default (proven, unpinned).

plan-deep.description: Phase 3 (Complex Integration): High-reasoning task decomposition across multi-service boundaries ($0.66/M input, $0.022/M cache read). Thinking: high.

tdd.description: Phase 4: High-frequency, low-cost TDD unit test generation and red-green verification loops ($0.15/M input, $0.03/M cache read). Thinking: provider default (proven, unpinned).

build.description: Phase 5 (Standard): Rapid multi-file feature construction and boilerplate updates ($0.15/M input). Thinking: provider default (proven, unpinned).

build-complex.description: Phase 5 (Complex Multi-File): Specialized repo-aware multi-file microservice edits ($0.95/M input). No thinking variants on this model.

reviewer.description: Phase 6 (Standard): Automated read-only spec compliance and code quality review ($0.10/M input). Thinking: high.

reviewer-deep.description: Phase 6 (High-shape): Deep read-only review for security-sensitive plans (auth/CSP/MF) — catches what flash-tier cannot self-assess ($0.66/M input, $0.022/M cache read). Thinking: high. Standing item, retro 2026-10-20.

finalize.description: Phase 7: Branch cleanup, full test execution, and PR preparation ($0.10/M input up to 272K context, $0.20/$0.75 above — avoids claude-haiku-5-5's 5x >100K tier cliff). Thinking: low (mechanical gate-running).

explore.description: Zero-cost repository indexing and file structural searching. Thinking: medium (quality is free; balances latency).
